## SCHOLARLY + DS&A CONTEXT
# ALGORITHM: Hash chain verification (SHA-256)
#   source:      §VII Security Primitives
#   complexity:  time O(n) for full chain verification · space O(1) streaming
#   parameters:  SHA-256 digest (32 bytes), chain links: hash(prev_hash + event_data)
#   security:    Tamper evidence — any modified entry breaks the chain from that point forward
#   invariants:
#     - Every audit entry carries prev_hash (SHA-256 of the preceding entry)
#     - hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || actor_id || action || target || timestamp || payload_hash)
#     - Chain verification is read-only — never modifies audit records
#     - Broken chain detected at first mismatched link, reported with entry index

## Summary
Build a FERPA audit log viewer that displays all data access events with hash chain integrity verification, allowing admins to detect any tampering with the audit trail.

## User story
As an admin, I want to view a tamper-evident audit log of all FERPA-sensitive data access events, so that I can demonstrate compliance during audits and detect unauthorized modifications to the log.

## Why this matters
FERPA requires institutions to maintain records of who accesses student education records. If the audit log can be silently modified, the compliance guarantee is void. The hash chain makes tampering detectable: modifying any entry breaks the chain from that point forward, providing cryptographic evidence of integrity.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Audit log viewer displays paginated entries: actor, action, target, timestamp
- [ ] Each entry shows its hash chain status (verified/broken chain indicator)
- [ ] Admin can trigger full chain verification — walks all entries, reports first break if any
- [ ] Verification result displayed as a badge: "Chain intact (N entries)" or "Chain broken at entry #K"
- [ ] Audit log is scoped to admin's institution_id
- [ ] Entries are filterable by: actor, action type, date range
- [ ] Audit log entries are append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE policies in RLS)
- [ ] Hash chain computation: hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || actor_id || action || target || timestamp || payload_hash)

## Schema changes
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.audit_log (
  id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.institutions(id),
  actor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  action TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'view_student_record', 'export_grades', 'modify_assessment', etc.
  target_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'student_record', 'assessment_item', 'grade', etc.
  target_id UUID,
  payload JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, -- SHA-256 of payload
  prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL, -- SHA-256 of previous entry (genesis = '0' * 64)
  entry_hash TEXT NOT NULL, -- SHA-256(prev_hash || actor_id || action || target || timestamp || payload_hash)
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.audit_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Admins can only READ audit entries for their institution (append-only enforced)
CREATE POLICY "Admins can read audit log for own institution"
  ON public.audit_log FOR SELECT
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid())
    AND (SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) = 'admin');

-- No UPDATE or DELETE policies — audit log is append-only
-- INSERT is done via service_role in server-side triggers/functions only

CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_institution ON public.audit_log (institution_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_actor ON public.audit_log (actor_id, created_at DESC);
```

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/admin/audit?page=1&limit=50&actor_id=X&action=Y&from=DATE&to=DATE
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    entries: Array<{
      id: number, actor_id: string, actor_name: string,
      action: string, target_type: string, target_id: string | null,
      entry_hash: string, prev_hash: string,
      created_at: string
    }>,
    total: number,
    page: number,
    limit: number
  },
  error: null
}

POST /app/api/admin/audit/verify
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    intact: boolean,
    entries_checked: number,
    broken_at: number | null, -- entry ID where chain breaks, null if intact
    message: string
  },
  error: null
}
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/admin/services/AuditService.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';

export class AuditService {
  /**
   * Verify the hash chain integrity for the institution's audit log.
   * O(n) time, O(1) space — streams entries in order.
   */
  async verifyChain(): Promise<{ intact: boolean; entriesChecked: number; brokenAt: number | null }> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data: entries, error } = await supabase
      .from('audit_log')
      .select('id, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, payload_hash, prev_hash, entry_hash, created_at')
      .order('id', { ascending: true });

    if (error) throw error;

    let expectedPrevHash = '0'.repeat(64); // genesis hash
    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
      const entry = entries[i];
      // Verify prev_hash links to previous entry
      if (entry.prev_hash !== expectedPrevHash) {
        return { intact: false, entriesChecked: i + 1, brokenAt: entry.id };
      }
      // Verify entry_hash is correct
      const computedHash = this.computeEntryHash(entry, entry.prev_hash);
      if (entry.entry_hash !== computedHash) {
        return { intact: false, entriesChecked: i + 1, brokenAt: entry.id };
      }
      expectedPrevHash = entry.entry_hash;
    }

    return { intact: true, entriesChecked: entries.length, brokenAt: null };
  }

  private computeEntryHash(entry: any, prevHash: string): string {
    const payload = `${prevHash}|${entry.actor_id}|${entry.action}|${entry.target_type}|${entry.created_at}|${entry.payload_hash}`;
    return createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex');
  }
}

// app/(admin)/audit/page.tsx — < 30 lines
import { AuditLogViewer } from '@/features/admin/components/AuditLogViewer';
export default function AuditPage() {
  return <AuditLogViewer />;
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Allowing UPDATE/DELETE on audit_log — breaks tamper-evidence
await supabase.from('audit_log').update({ action: 'modified' }).eq('id', 1); // BANNED
// Audit log is append-only — no RLS UPDATE/DELETE policies exist

// ✗ Computing hash on client side — exposes hash internals
// Hash verification MUST run server-side in the API route
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S06.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/admin/audit returns paginated audit entries', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/audit?page=1&limit=10');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('entries');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('total');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('page');
});

test('POST /api/admin/audit/verify returns chain verification result', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/audit/verify');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('intact');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('entries_checked');
  expect(typeof body.data.intact).toBe('boolean');
});

test('GET /api/admin/audit supports filtering by action', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/audit?action=view_student_record');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  body.data.entries.forEach((entry: any) => {
    expect(entry.action).toBe('view_student_record');
  });
});

test('GET /api/admin/audit returns 401 for unauthenticated request', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/audit');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

test('Negative: non-admin cannot access audit log', async ({ request }) => {
  // Using faculty-role session
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/audit');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403);
});

// tests/E02/E02-S06.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Audit log page renders with entries table', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/audit');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /audit/i })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('table')).toBeVisible();
});

test('Audit log page has verify chain button', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/audit');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /verify/i })).toBeVisible();
});

test('Verify chain shows result badge', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/audit');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /verify/i }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/chain intact|chain broken/i)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
});
```

2. No Neo4j changes to revert.
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
